question:
Fill in the blanks:

In Carnatic music, a laghu consisting of five beats is termed _____ jaati.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khanda**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **Carnatic music**, rhythm or tala is one of the most important aspects of composition and performance. A tala is divided into different components, one of which is the **laghu**.
 
• A **laghu** in Carnatic music is a rhythmic unit that consists of a variable number of beats, determined by the **jaati** (classification).
 
• The jaati defines the number of beats in the laghu. There are five jaatis in Carnatic music: **Tishra (3 beats), Chaturashra (4 beats), Khanda (5 beats), Mishra (7 beats),** and **Sankeerna (9 beats).**
 
• When a laghu consists of **five beats**, it is specifically referred to as the **Khanda Jaati Laghu.**
